title: How Rolex Really Makes Money (The CHF 11 Billion Secret)
description:
Rolex is estimated to have sold more than CHF 11 billion of watches in 2025, about a third of the whole Swiss watch industry, yet it has no shareholders and publishes no accounts. In this file we open the money machine behind Rolex: an importer in London, the name that sounds like a watch being wound, the Channel swim that sold the waterproof Oyster, the foundation that owns 100% of the company and can never sell it, the scarcity machine behind the waiting lists, the CHF 1 billion factory in Bulle, Bucherer and Certified Pre-Owned, and the latest numbers.

{CHAPTERS}

Sources: Morgan Stanley x LuxeConsult Swiss watch industry reports (as reported by Robb Report, The Peak and Monochrome Watches); Vontobel estimates (Monochrome Watches); Rolex newsroom (Certified Pre-Owned); National Jeweler (Bucherer); swissinfo.ch and Gear Patrol (Bulle factory); Grey Market Magazine / Luxury Bazaar (retail network); DMARGE; European Business Magazine; Wikipedia (Rolex).

Rolex is private and does not publish financial results: all sales and production figures are analyst estimates and are rounded. The average sales per watch is our own arithmetic. The foundation's charitable giving is a reported estimate. This video is for education only, not investment advice.
